Boundary Detection Boundary detection, often referred to as edge detection , is a fundamental concept in computer vision. It plays a crucial role in identifying the boundaries of objects within an image. These boundaries represent significant changes in intensity or color and are essential for various computer vision tasks, such as object recognition, image segmentation, and feature extraction . Edges in an image are critical because they contain important information about the shapes and structures present. By detecting edges, computer vision algorithms can focus on these key regions, making it easier to analyze and interpret the content of an image. FAST NUCES - Karachi Talha Shahid 5
